projects.name: AutoTradingBot
projects.summary: Autonomous long-only portfolio manager in Go. Indicators, news and an LLM decide buy, sell or hold across stocks, ETFs, bond ETFs and cash. Bracket orders on Alpaca, risk limits enforced in code. Paper-tested with autonomous, real-time trade execution. Benchmarked against SPY and a 60/40 portfolio.

projects.name: Stock-Quant-Reports
projects.summary: Equity report generator for a student-managed investment fund: ticker in, two-page PDF out with weekly and monthly indicators, charts, narrative and a rule-based signal. Saves 5+ hours a week of manual analysis and feeds the fund's decisions.

projects.name: DeFi lending protocol
projects.summary: Over-collateralized lending protocol in Solidity using Foundry and Chainlink price feeds, with utilization-based interest, health-factor liquidations and explicit bad debt. Verified against an independent C++ model; fuzz, invariant and fork tests at 100% coverage. Educational project, not audited, never used with real funds.
